title: In-app search relevance
structure_note: Problem -> target user -> success metrics -> in/out of scope -> epics
tone_note: Short declarative problem statement. Metrics always paired with a current baseline, never a bare target.
excerpt: PROBLEM: Users cannot find work they created more than two weeks ago; 31% of sessions include a failed search. TARGET USER: Daily active editor with >200 items. SUCCESS: failed-search rate 31% -> 12%.

title: Bulk import from CSV and rival exports
structure_note: Same skeleton; out-of-scope section used aggressively to kill adjacent asks
tone_note: Every scope line traces to a named piece of evidence (interview id or metric).
excerpt: OUT OF SCOPE: live two-way sync (asked for by 3 of 11 interviewees, deferred — no evidence it drives activation).
